name: Kamizato Kyou
source:
Half-American, half-Japanese, Kyou's beautiful looks makes him popular amongst the female students. They pine for and call him "Kyou-sama". However, he finds this a nuisance and doesn't seem to be proud of it. His apathetic, lazy conduct when it comes to his school life stands out. Perhaps because he has a younger sister, he has a caring side to him.

[Translation of his [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/kyo.html]official website profile[/URL].]
